examples.arabic: تطبخ امي وليمة كبيرة من الطعام العربي اللذيذ
examples.english: My mother cooks a big feast of delicious Arabic food.
examples.transliteration: Tatbukhu ummee waleematon kabeeraton min attaaam alarabee alladheeth

examples.arabic: تجتمع العائلة حول المائدة الكبيرة وتملا رائحة الطعام اللذيذ المكان
examples.english: The family gathers around the large table and the smell of delicious food fills the place.
examples.transliteration: Tajtamiu al aila hawla al maida al kabira wa tamla raihat at taam al ladhidh al makan

examples.arabic: أوه، لقد نسيت تماماً بسبب انشغالي بالأخبار العاجلة، دعنا إذن نؤدي صلاتنا أولاً ثم نطلب طعامنا اللذيذ.
examples.english: Oh, I completely forgot due to my busyness with the breaking news, let us then perform our prayer first then order our delicious food.
examples.transliteration: Oh, laqad nasitu tamaman bisabab inshighali bil-akhbar al-'ajila, da'na idhan nu'addi salatana awwalan thumma natlub ta'amana al-ladhidh.
examples.storyTitle: A Rainy Day and Changed Plans

examples.english: My grandmother gives me delicious cake.
examples.transliteration: tuutini jaddati al kaak al ladhidh
examples.storyTitle: A Visit to My Grandfather's House

examples.arabic: على مائدة الطعام قدموا لنا طبقا تقليديا بمذاق لذيذ جدا
examples.english: On the dining table, they served us a traditional dish with a very delicious taste.
examples.transliteration: Ala ma'idat at-ta'am qaddamoo lanā tabaqan taqleediyan bi-madhaq ladheedh jiddan.

examples.arabic: جلس الجميع حول المائدة وقال الاب هذا عشاء لذيذ جدا شكرا لك يا امي
examples.english: Everyone sat around the table, and the father said "This is a very delicious dinner, thank you, Mother!"
examples.transliteration: Jalasa al-jami' hawla al-ma'idah wa qala al-ab hatha asha' ladhidh jiddan shukran laki ya ummi
